name: Single-Leg Bridge (Dance)
description: Single-leg hip bridge — posterior-chain strength for jumps and takeoffs in dance.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine, one foot flat, other leg extended. Drive through the heel, lift hips while keeping pelvis square. Lower with control. 10-12 per side.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Deficit)
description: Unilateral calf raise off a step — essential for ski boot push-off and skimo climbing.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one foot with the ball of the foot on a step, heel hanging below. Slowly lower the heel past the step for 3 seconds, then rise to full plantar flexion. 12-15 reps per side.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise (Eccentric, Loaded)
description: Loaded eccentric calf raise — builds tendon resilience for long descents and rough terrain.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a dumbbell in one hand, stand on the ball of the same-side foot on a step. Rise to full calf raise with both feet, then shift weight and slowly (3-5s) lower the loaded-side heel below the step.

name: Single-Leg Deadlift (Backpack)
description: Unilateral hinge holding a weighted pack low — hamstring and balance work that mirrors the terrain step-over.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a pack in both hands or wear it. Balance on one leg, hinge at the hip, extending the back leg as a counterweight. Return by squeezing the planted glute. 8 per side.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
description: Unilateral glute activation — cornerstone for any runner with a knee or IT-band history.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on back, one knee bent 90°, other leg extended. Drive through the planted heel to lift hips, keeping pelvis level. Lower under control. Complete reps; switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Heel Drop (Eccentric)
description: Eccentric-focused calf work — the Alfredson protocol for Achilles health.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a step with the ball of one foot, heel off the edge. Rise to double-leg calf raise. Shift weight to one leg and slowly lower that heel below the step level over 3 seconds. Use the other leg to return to the top.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
description: Unilateral hip thrust — the lift that mirrors bridging, scrambling out of bottom, and sprawling to one side.
instructions_excerpt: Upper back on a bench, one foot planted, other leg lifted. Drive the grounded heel into the floor and lift hips until hip, knee, and shoulder form a straight line. Squeeze glute hard at top. Pause 1s. Lower with control.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust on Bench
description: Single-leg hip thrust — glute strength critical for pop-up drive and stance stability.
instructions_excerpt: Upper back on a bench, feet on floor. Extend one leg straight. Drive through the planted heel to lift the hips to full extension. Lower slow.

name: Single-Leg RDL with Rotation
description: Single-leg RDL with a torso rotation at the bottom — hip-hinge balance and rotational stability for surfers/SUP.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg with a DB in the opposite hand. Hinge forward on the standing leg until the torso is parallel. At the bottom, rotate the torso slightly open. Return to standing.

name: Single-Leg Relevé with Balance
description: Unilateral relevé held on one leg — balance + calf strength for pointe work and turns.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg. Rise onto the ball of the foot and hold 5-10 seconds. Lower with control. Switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
description: Unilateral hinge — hamstring/glute strength plus balance.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg, slight knee bend. Hinge at the hips, extending the back leg behind like a counterweight. Lower until the torso is parallel-ish to the floor. Return by squeezing the planted glute.

name: Single-Leg Skater Squat
description: Unilateral knee-dominant squat that mimics the edge-by-edge load of carving and telemark transitions.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg, the other leg trailing behind with the knee just above the floor. Squat by sitting the hips back and bending the standing knee until the trailing knee kisses the floor. Drive up through the mid-foot. Use a light TRX or door frame for balance at first.

name: Single-Leg Squat to Box
description: Unilateral knee-dominant strength — ski/snowboard cornerstone.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg in front of a box, bench, or sturdy chair. Sit back to tap the box with the hip, extending the opposite leg forward for balance. Return to standing by driving through the planted foot.

name: Sit-Up
description: Bodyweight sit-up — full trunk flexion with hip-flexor involvement.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat or anchored. Sit up by curling the spine off the floor until torso is vertical, lower under control.

name: Skater's Step-Down (Eccentric)
description: Slow eccentric step-down emphasizing knee control during deceleration — protects skater knees.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on one leg on a 6-12" box. Over 3-4 seconds, slowly lower the other leg to tap the floor, controlling with the standing leg. Return to standing.

name: Ski-Jumping In-Run Tuck Isometric
description: Deep tuck isometric hold — ski jumping and downhill in-run position.
instructions_excerpt: Assume a deep-squat tuck with elbows outside the knees, chest over thighs, arms relaxed. Hold 20-45s. 3-4 sets.

name: Skull Crusher (Lying Triceps Extension)
description: Lying triceps extension — direct triceps stretch and isolation, bodybuilding staple.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine on a bench holding an EZ-bar or dumbbells overhead with arms vertical. Keeping elbows fixed, lower the weight toward the forehead (or just past). Extend back to vertical.

name: Sled Pull (Backward Drag)
description: Backward sled drag — quad-dominant, knee-friendly conditioning with minimal soreness cost.
instructions_excerpt: Face the sled with handles or straps. Walk backward, pulling the sled by staying low and driving the heels into the ground on each step. 30-60 feet per effort.

name: Sled Push (Heavy)
description: Heavy prowler / sled push — leg-drive strength with near-zero eccentric cost, ideal for strongman and football carryover.
instructions_excerpt: Set the sled with heavy load. Grip the posts with arms long, body at a strong forward lean. Drive through big powerful steps, full leg extension each stride. Push 30-50 ft. Rest 2-3 min.

name: Snatch Pull
description: Snatch lift through the second pull, no catch — overhead-pull strength builder.
instructions_excerpt: Set up with snatch-width grip. Pull from the floor, extend explosively at the hips and shrug hard, no catch. Land flat-footed.

name: Split-Stance Iso Hold
description: Wall-supported split-squat isometric hold — pre-event-safe knee and quad loading.
instructions_excerpt: Set up in a split stance with the back foot elevated on a bench (or on the floor), torso upright, hands against a wall for support if desired. Lower to ~90° front knee. Hold 20-30 seconds. 3-4 holds per side.

name: Split-Stance Isometric (Telemark Sit)
description: Isometric split stance — trains the telemark and skimo uphill posture.
instructions_excerpt: Step into a deep split stance, back knee hovering just above the floor. Hold 30-60 seconds, weight 60% on front leg. Switch sides.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Bilateral gastroc strength.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a step or flat floor. Rise onto the balls of the feet as high as possible. Pause. Lower slowly to full range.

name: Standing Oblique Crunch with Club
description: Standing oblique crunch holding a weighted club — sport-specific oblique work.
instructions_excerpt: Stand tall holding a clubbell or light dumbbell overhead. Side-bend slowly toward the weighted side. 8-10 per side.

name: Standing Single-Arm Landmine Row
description: Standing landmine row, one arm at a time — core anti-rotation + pulling strength for paddlers.
instructions_excerpt: Stand beside a landmine. Hinge, grip the sleeve with one hand. Row the bar to the ribs without rotating the torso. Lower slow.

name: Step-Up with Pack (High Box)
description: High box step-up carrying a pack — translates directly to big uphill steps with a loaded kit.
instructions_excerpt: Wear a weighted pack. Step up onto a knee-height or slightly higher box with one foot, drive through the heel to stand tall, and lower with control. Alternate sides.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
description: Deadlift with minimal knee bend and lower-back rounding — heavy hamstring/erector emphasis.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with feet hip-width, bar in front. Keep knees nearly straight. Hinge at hips, lower bar past shins, then drive hips forward to stand. Maintain neutral spine.

name: Streamline Hold (Supine)
description: Isometric full-body extension in swimmer streamline position — proprioceptive + postural.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine, arms extended overhead (biceps by ears), legs long and glued together. Engage every muscle to form a rigid line. Hold 20-40 seconds.

name: Suitcase Carry
description: Unilateral loaded carry — anti-lateral-flexion core, grip, and trap endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in one hand. Stand tall, shoulders level. Walk 40-60 feet without letting the loaded side hip drop. Switch hands.

name: Suitcase Carry (Ski Tour Load)
description: Unilateral loaded carry — anti-lateral-flexion core + grip staple for backcountry touring and pack days.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a single heavy dumbbell or kettlebell in one hand. Stand tall, shoulders level, chin over sternum. Walk 20-30 m. Switch hands, repeat. Do not let the loaded side sag.

name: Sumo Deadlift
description: Wide-stance deadlift — shorter pull range, hip- and adductor-driven.
instructions_excerpt: Stance wide, toes turned out 30-45°, grip the bar inside the legs. Drop hips, chest up, pull the bar straight up by pushing the floor away. Stand and lock out.

name: Superman Hold
description: Prone hold with arms/legs lifted — builds the posterior-chain extension essential for freestyle body position.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down, arms extended overhead. Lift the chest, arms, and legs off the floor simultaneously. Hold for 15-45 seconds. Breathe throughout.

name: Suspension Trainer Row (TRX)
description: Body-row variation with TRX — adjustable difficulty and portable, great traveling-surfer pull option.
instructions_excerpt: Hold TRX handles; lean back with feet forward so arms are extended. Pull chest to handles, driving elbows back and squeezing the upper back. Lower with control.

name: Sword Draw Iso Hold (Iaido)
description: Half-drawn sword iso hold — builds the forearm and shoulder endurance for iaido drawing (nukitsuke).
instructions_excerpt: In seiza or standing, hold a bokken or PVC with one hand, handle at hip, tip-forward, half-drawn. Hold 30-45s with other hand on sheath proxy.

name: T-Bar Row
description: Landmine or T-bar handle row — bilateral horizontal pull with mixed-grip handle.
instructions_excerpt: Straddle the bar with V-handle attached at the loaded end. Hinge to ~45°, brace, row the handle to the lower chest.

name: Thick-Bar (Fat Grip) Hang
description: Dead hang from a thick bar (or Fat Gripz) — grip endurance for sailors, climbers, and spearfishing line-work.
instructions_excerpt: Attach Fat Gripz or grip a 2"+ thick bar. Hang with arms long, shoulders engaged. Target 20-60 seconds per hang.

name: Thruster
description: Combined front squat + push press — CrossFit benchmark movement.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a barbell or dumbbells at the shoulders in front-rack. Squat to parallel. Drive up explosively, using the leg drive to press the weight overhead. Return to front-rack.

name: Tiller-Extension Rotational Row
description: Seated rotational cable row — sailors' steering-arm endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Sit sideways on a bench with a cable anchored forward. Holding a handle, row the cable back while rotating the torso. Return under control. 8-10 per side.

name: Toes-to-Bar
description: Advanced core + grip movement — hanging leg raise all the way to the bar.
instructions_excerpt: Hang from a pull-up bar with tight grip. Engage the core and lats to drive the feet up to touch the bar. Lower under control.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
description: Hex-bar deadlift — athlete-friendly deadlift variation that hits quads and posterior chain without the spinal demand of a barbell pull.
instructions_excerpt: Stand inside a hex bar. Hinge and grip handles. Set a neutral spine, drive through floor to stand tall. Lower under control.

name: Trapeze Plank Hold
description: Plank with feet elevated and straight-arm grip — catamaran/skiff trapeze-style iso.
instructions_excerpt: Plank with feet on a low bench, arms straight, hands on the floor, body in line. Hold 30-45s.

name: Tricep Kickback (Dumbbell)
description: Bent-over single-arm dumbbell kickback — strict triceps isolation.
instructions_excerpt: Hinge over with one hand on a bench. Pin upper arm parallel to torso. Extend the elbow until arm is straight, squeeze, return with control.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Cable triceps pushdown with V-bar or straight bar — primary cable triceps lift.
instructions_excerpt: Stand at a high cable with a V-bar or straight bar attached. Tuck elbows at sides, push the bar down to lockout, squeeze triceps. Return with control.

name: Triceps Extension (Dumbbell, Overhead)
description: Long-head triceps work — supports lock-offs and pushing.
instructions_excerpt: Stand or sit tall holding a single dumbbell overhead with both hands cupping the top end. Lower the dumbbell behind the head by bending only at the elbows (upper arms stay vertical). Extend back overhead.

name: Tuck Hold (Skiing-Specific)
description: Low tuck hold in a downhill racer's position — specific ski fitness in one movement.
instructions_excerpt: Feet hip width, shins pressed forward (as if into ski boots), chest over thighs, forearms on thighs, hips low. Hold 30-60 seconds. Breathe.

name: Tuck L-Sit Progression
description: L-sit foundation — hip-flexor and core compression for calisthenics.
instructions_excerpt: Sit on the floor or parallettes with hands planted. Depress shoulders and lift both knees tucked toward the chest, hips off the floor. Hold 10-20 seconds.

name: Turkish Get-Up
description: Full-body ground-to-standing loaded movement — THE kettlebell exercise for grapplers.
instructions_excerpt: Lie on back holding a kettlebell vertically in one hand, arm locked out. Roll up to a seated position, then to a knee, then stand, keeping the weight overhead throughout. Reverse the sequence to return. Switch sides.

name: Turkish Get-Up (Light Load)
description: Ground-to-standing progression under load — shoulder stability + full-body control for alpine scrambling recovery-if-slip scenarios.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a light KB or water bottle overhead. Lie on your back. Roll to elbow, to hand, sweep leg, lunge, stand. Reverse sequence. 3 per side.

name: Ultimate Frisbee Layout Core-Plank
description: Extended plank with reach — prepares the layout (dive-catch) position core demand.
instructions_excerpt: From plank, reach one arm forward to full extension, hold 3-5 sec, return. Alternate arms. 8-10 per side.

name: Upright Row (Barbell)
description: Barbell upright row — traps and lateral-delt work; shoulder-position aware.
instructions_excerpt: Stand with barbell at hip-width grip. Pull the bar up the body to mid-chest, elbows leading high. Lower with control. Stop short of shoulder pain.

name: V-Up
description: V-up — simultaneous trunk and hip flexion meeting in a V shape.
instructions_excerpt: Lie flat on back, arms overhead. Simultaneously raise legs and torso to meet over the hips, reaching hands toward feet. Lower with control.

name: Walking Lunge
description: Loaded walking lunge — alternating-leg quad/glute work that progresses distance.
instructions_excerpt: Hold dumbbells at the sides (or bar on back). Step forward into a lunge, knee tracking over toes, then push off the back leg and step forward into the next lunge.

name: Wall Sit
description: Quad-endurance isometric — useful for cyclists, skiers, and hikers.
instructions_excerpt: Lean against a wall with feet out far enough that when you slide down, thighs are parallel to the floor and knees at 90°. Hold position. Breathe.

name: Wall Sit (Ski Tuck)
description: Isometric quad hold in a low tuck position — the single best sliver of ski-specific strength for an off-day.
instructions_excerpt: Back flat against a wall, feet shoulder-width and out far enough that knees end at 90 degrees. Slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor. Hands off thighs. Hold 30-90 seconds. Breathe through the burn.

name: Wall Walk (Handstand Approach)
description: Walk the feet up a wall into handstand position — builds inversion confidence and shoulder endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Start in push-up facing away from wall. Walk feet up the wall while hands walk toward the wall until reaching handstand. Reverse.

name: Weighted Carry in Surf-Stance
description: Loaded walk in a surf-style staggered stance — asymmetric core + lower body for surf/wake.
instructions_excerpt: Stand in a surf-stance (feet staggered sideways to travel direction). Hold a heavy dumbbell in the back hand. Walk slow, controlled, 20-30 m. Switch stance.

name: Weighted Carve Squat
description: Rotational squat with torso rotation — mimics pumping/carving on a skateboard/surfboard.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a light DB or plate at chest. Squat to parallel while rotating the torso toward one knee. Stand and rotate to the other knee on the next rep.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
description: Loaded vertical pull — the strongest direct transfer to steep climbing.
instructions_excerpt: Hang from a pull-up bar with a weight belt or dumbbell between feet. Start with arms fully extended and shoulders engaged (scapulae depressed and slightly retracted). Pull until chin clears the bar with chest lifting toward the bar. Lower with a 2-3s eccentric to full hang. Keep legs long and core b

name: Weighted Vest Step-Up
description: Step-ups with a weighted vest — specific to backcountry hunters and bow hunters managing steep terrain under pack load.
instructions_excerpt: Wear a weighted vest (15-30 lb). Step up onto a 12-18" box with one foot, stand tall, lower with control. Complete reps on one side before switching.

name: Windsurf Harness-Lean Iso
description: Forward-lean isometric hold — windsurf harness-hook-in position simulation.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on heels, toes slightly lifted. Lean forward from ankles against a firm band anchored at waist height. Hold 20-45s.

name: Wrestler Bridge (Neck Bridge Warmup)
description: Classic wrestler's bridge — neck extensor strength + posterior chain integration. Key for scrambles and bridging out from bottom.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine with feet close to hips, heels flat. Push hips up until you bridge onto the top of your head and feet, with hands supporting your weight on the mat beside your ears. Hold 10-20s. Lower with control.

name: Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
description: Seated dumbbell wrist curl — forearm-flexor strengthening, palms-up.
instructions_excerpt: Sit with forearm on thigh, palm up, dumbbell in hand. Let the wrist drop, then curl the weight up by flexing the wrist. Lower under control.

name: XC Skiing Double-Pole Simulation
description: Dryland double-pole power drill — direct cross-country skiing specific.
instructions_excerpt: Use cable or heavy band anchored high behind. Stand tall, drive both arms down-and-back to hip with simultaneous core flex. 10-15 reps.

name: Yogi Push-Up (Chaturanga)
description: Yoga-specific tricep push-up with elbows tight — key repeated pattern in vinyasa practice.
instructions_excerpt: From plank, shift slightly forward. Lower slowly keeping elbows tight to the body until upper arms are parallel to the floor. Pause, then flow to up-dog or push back up.

name: Yoke Walk
description: Loaded yoke carry — strongman signature for full-body stiffness under heavy axial load.
instructions_excerpt: Step under a loaded yoke with the pad across the upper traps. Brace hard, stand up, walk 40-60 ft with short controlled steps. Set down with control.

name: Zercher Carry
description: Front-loaded carry in the crook of the elbows — mimics pack-carry loading; hard core demand.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a barbell or sandbag in the crook of the elbows at chest height. Stand tall and walk 30-50 feet maintaining posture. Rest and repeat.

name: Zercher Good Morning
description: Front-loaded good morning — posterior chain strength in a grappler-specific trunk position (loaded chest, hip hinge).
instructions_excerpt: Hold a barbell in the crook of the elbows (Zercher). Feet shoulder-width. Hinge at the hips with a slight knee bend, keeping the chest up and spine neutral. Return by driving through the hips.
